scientific_limits: The frozen query diagnostic shows useful local TRAIN dependence; it does not prove missing information or causal native Adam interference.
Learned hash channels are multiscale features, not exact Fourier frequencies, FEM stiffness modes or explicit load paths.
Boundary union still loses DOF/patch identity and topology;1024 original FEM nodes give sparse nonuniform coverage.
Gain saturation and nearzero factors can suppress gradients; modulation benefit remains to be measured.
Adaptive known-CAD validation research is not finaltest, arbitrary BC/load generalization, multi-seed significance or a novel physics law.
One two-branch10k pair only; no automatic strength/form/kernel/loss/width/seed sweep or dia/finaltest opening.

query_context.pool_output: Gaussian weighted projected point32 -> non-affine LayerNorm32 -> tanh; bounded query32
query_context.native_input_layout: original38+query32+global32 conditions102 appended after modulated hash24; split native Network pads126 to128

scientific_limits: The frozen query diagnostic shows useful local TRAIN dependence; it does not prove missing information or causal native Adam interference.
Learned hash channels are multiscale features, not exact Fourier frequencies, FEM stiffness modes or explicit load paths.
Boundary union still loses DOF/patch identity and topology;1024 original FEM nodes give sparse nonuniform coverage.
Gain saturation and nearzero factors can suppress gradients; modulation benefit remains to be measured.
Adaptive known-CAD validation research is not finaltest, arbitrary BC/load generalization, multi-seed significance or a novel physics law.
One two-branch10k pair only; no automatic strength/form/kernel/loss/width/seed sweep or dia/finaltest opening.
